info.name: Get an organelle data report by taxon

params.name: taxons
params.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID or name (common or scientific) at any taxonomic rank

params.name: organelle_types
params.description: Limit results to the specified organelle types.

params.name: first_release_date
params.description: Limit results to organelle genomes released on or after the specified date.

params.name: last_release_date
params.description: Limit results to organelle genomes released on or before the specified date.

params.name: tax_exact_match
params.description: If true, only return assemblies with the given NCBI Taxonomy ID, or name. Otherwise, assemblies from taxonomy subtree are included, too.

params.name: returned_content
params.description: Return complete organelle reports or nucleotide accessions only.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of organelle assemblies to return. Default is 20 and maximum is 1000. If the number of results exceeds the page size, `page_token` can be used to retrieve the remaining results.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A page token is returned from an `OrganelleMetadata` call with more than `page_size` results. Use this token, along with the previous `OrganelleMetadata` parameters, to retrieve the next page of results. When `page_token` is empty, all results have been retrieved.

params.name: table_format
params.description: Specify a predefined set of fields for the tabular report using built-in templates. Use of this parameter requires the HTTP header, `accept: text/tab-separated-values`.

params.name: include_tabular_header
params.description: Specify when to include the table header when requesting a tabular report.
